tools.name: status
tools.description: Full bot state: position, health, movement, inventory.

tools.name: say
tools.description: Say something in chat as the bot. The ONLY way players hear you.

tools.name: move_to
tools.description: Walk toward coordinates relative to the bot (dx,dy,dz in blocks). Use status to check arrival.

tools.name: dig
tools.description: Break the block at relative coords.

tools.name: place
tools.description: Place the item in inventory slot against the block at relative coords.

tools.name: hold
tools.description: Hold inventory slot (0-35) in the main hand.

tools.name: tidy
tools.description: Merge and compact the whole inventory.

tools.name: give
tools.description: Drop count items from slot at the bot's feet for the owner.

tools.name: recipe
tools.description: Look up how to craft an item id, e.g. minecraft:torch.

tools.name: craft
tools.description: Craft one batch of an item id from inventory. Returns NEED:list when ingredients are missing.

tools.name: chest
tools.description: List a container's contents at relative coords.

tools.name: take
tools.description: Take item (optional count) from the container at relative coords.

tools.name: store
tools.description: Put the held/slot stack into the container at relative coords.

tools.name: furnace
tools.description: status, load (auto fuel+input), or take from the furnace at relative coords.

tools.name: eat
tools.description: Eat the best food in inventory.

tools.name: look
tools.description: What is around: nearby blocks, entities, containers.
